correctness.rationale: The proof reduces all d>=2 cases to the exact 2+1 geodesic-triple hypergraph. It proves equality on every induced K_{3,2,1}-free complete multipartite subgraph by explicit one- or two-colorings and exact clique-bound values, and proves failure on K_{3,2,1} by chi=3 versus omega=4. Every nonperfect profile contains K_{3,2,1}, and every vertex deletion from K_{3,2,1} falls into a proved perfect profile. Direct definition-level computation through order eight agrees for d=2,3,4.
